# AdcsApplication

## Overview {.unnumbered .unlisted}

`AdcsApplication` is the Layer 3 Active component for the ADCS subsystem. It owns the attitude control loop and switches operating mode on command from `SatStateMachine`. It dispatches actuator commands to Layer 2 hardware managers (`IMMUManager`, `SunSensorManager`, `MagnetorquerManager`) and consumes attitude from `StarTrackerManager` and timing from `GnssManager`.

Attitude estimation and all control law computation are internal to `AdcsApplication` itself. `AdcsApplication` receives raw sensor data directly from the hardware managers and `StarTrackerManager`, maintains its own cached state estimate, and runs internal control functions: `DetumbleController` in `Detumble`, `SlewLimiter` in the three maneuvering pointing modes, and `PointingController` in steady-state `AttitudeHold`. It then turns that estimate into a commanded magnetic moment.

**ADCS software topology**:

![ADCS application topology diagram](../../Adcs/images/AdcsApplicationTopology.png){width=100%}


## Requirements {.unnumbered .unlisted}

| ID | Requirement | Verification |
|----|-------------|--------------|
| HS2-ADC-001 | AdcsApplication shall detumble the spacecraft | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-002 | AdcsApplication shall point the spacecraft at a commanded target quaternion | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-003 | AdcsApplication shall maintain a slew rate under 0.04 degrees per second upon command | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-004 | AdcsApplication shall respond to health pings within the required deadline | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-005 | AdcsApplication shall assert WARNING_HI events followed by a FATAL if hardware is unable to recover from errors | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-006 | AdcsApplication shall answer IMMUManager's `configureDataRequest` with connection port name, accel, gyro, and magnetometer data rates, and startup wait time | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-007 | AdcsApplication shall lock MagnetorquerManager and assert the IMMUManager magnetic disturbance flag together, and unlock and clear them together | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-008 | AdcsApplication shall update its internal estimated angular rate on each received IMU sample | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-009 | AdcsApplication shall update its internal estimated attitude quaternion on each received star tracker attitude sample | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-010 | AdcsApplication shall update its internal sun vector estimate on each received sun vector sample | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-011 | AdcsApplication shall record the timestamp of each received measurement, per source (IMU, sun vector, star tracker) | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-012 | AdcsApplication shall retain the previous B-field measurement for use by `DetumbleController`'s derivative term | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-013 | AdcsApplication shall compute a magnetic moment vector from the current B-field and previous Bfield via `DetumbleController` (using B-dot law) while in `Detumble` | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-014 | AdcsApplication shall compute a magnetic moment vector from the estimated attitude, angular rate, target quaternion, and B-field via `PointingController` (quaternion PD control law) while in `AttitudeHold` | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-015 | AdcsApplication shall compute a magnetic moment vector via `SlewLimiter`, capping the commanded rotation to the active slew limit, while in `SunPointing`, `AntennaPointing`, or `EarthLimbPointing` | Inspection |
| HS2-ADC-016 | AdcsApplication shall compute a body frame sun vector via `SunVectorEstimator` from the six calibrated intensities published by `SunSensorManager` | Inspection |



## Design {.unnumbered .unlisted}

### Component Type {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Active component with internal hierarchical F' state machine (`Fw::Sm`).

### Mode Interface {.unnumbered .unlisted}

`AdcsApplication` receives its operating mode from `SatStateMachine` via a typed port:

```fpp
sync input port modeIn: Sat.AdcsModePort   # carries Adcs.Mode
```

Mode enum (owned by this component's module):

```fpp
module Adcs {
    enum Mode { Off, Detumble, SunPointing, AntennaPointing, EarthLimbPointing, AttitudeHold }
}
```

If the incoming mode matches the current mode, the handler returns immediately.

### Ports {.unnumbered .unlisted}

| Port | Direction | Type | Purpose |
|------|-----------|------|---------|
| `modeIn` | Input | `Sat.AdcsModePort` | Mode command from SatStateMachine |
| `schedIn` | Input | `Svc.Sched` | Rate group tick (10 Hz) |
| `immuConfigureGet` | Input (sync) | `immuConfigurationParameters_p` → `Adcs.ConfigureParameters` | Answers IMMUManager's `configureDataRequest` |
| `immuDataIn` | Input (async) | `Adcs.ImmuDataPort` | IMMU angular rate + acceleration sample from `IMMUManager`; updates the internal angular rate estimate |
| `sunIntensitiesIn` | Input (async) | `Adcs.SunIntensityPort` | Six calibrated channel intensities + timestamp from `SunSensorManager` run through `SunVectorEstimator` to update the internal sun vector estimate |
| `attitudeIn` | Input (async) | `Adcs.AttitudePort` | Absolute attitude quaternion from `StarTrackerManager` that updates the internal attitude estimate |
| `sunSensorControl` | Output | `Adcs.ManagerControlPort` | ON/OFF command to SunSensorManager |
| `magnetorquerLock` | Output | `mtToggle_p` (`is_locked: bool`) | Lock/unlock command to MagnetorquerManager |
| `immuDisturbanceOut` | Output | `mtToggle_p` (`is_locked: bool`) | Magnetic disturbance flag to IMMUManager which is asserted/cleared together with `magnetorquerLock` |
| `momentVectorOut` | Output | `Adcs.MomentVectorPort` | Send computed moment vector to MagnetorquerManager |
| `positionGet` | Output | `Fw.Dp` | Request position/timing from GnssManager |
| `pingIn` / `pingOut` | In/Out | `Svc.Ping` | Health monitoring |
| `logOut` | Output | `Fw.Log` | Event logging |
| `tlmOut` | Output | `Fw.Tlm` | Telemetry |


### Internal State Estimate {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Referred to as `AttitudeFilter` in the diagrams below (its name when it was a separate component) — internal to `AdcsApplication` now, not a distinct component.

| Field | Updated by | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Estimated attitude quaternion | `attitudeIn` | Most recent absolute attitude from `StarTrackerManager` |
| Estimated angular rate | `immuDataIn` | Most recent angular rate from `IMMUManager` |
| Estimated angular acceleration | `immuDataIn` | Difference of consecutive angular rate samples over the tick period. `SlewLimiter` needs this in addition to rate |
| Sun vector estimate | `sunIntensitiesIn`, via `SunVectorEstimator` | Sun vector computed from the six calibrated intensities |
| Current & previous B-field | `immuDataIn` | Current and prior B-feild, retained for `DetumbleController`'s derivative term |
| Timestamps | each of the above | Last received time for IMU, sun vector, and star tracker samples, used to judge data freshness |

#### Kalman filter

- **State vector:** attitude quaternion `q`, angular velocity `ω` (3), gyro bias `b_g` (3), 9-element error-state covariance (`Matrix<9>`) over attitude-error/rate/bias. Parameters are `sigma_gyr` (gyro noise), `sigma_omega_rw` (rate random walk), `sigma_bg_rw` (bias random walk), `sigma_st` (star tracker noise)

**9-state MEKF** Attitude error (3) + angular velocity (3) + gyro bias (3) as filter states. Gyro readings treated as a noisy *measurement* of a separately propagating rate state (Kalman corrected each tick), not fed straight into propagation. Prediction created by propagating quaternion via kinematics driven by the current rate estimate, propagating the 9×9 covariance with process noise `sigma_omega_rw`/`sigma_bg_rw`. Star tracker gives a full quaternion correction (`sigma_st`), gyro gives a rate correction (`sigma_gyr`).


### Internal Control Functions {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Three control law computations are internal functions inside `AdcsApplication`. 

| Function | Inputs | Output | Called from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DetumbleController` | Current B-field, previous B-field | Magnetic moment vector computed from the change in the B-field using the B-dot law. | `DETUMBLE`/`RUNNING`, each tick. The only control function active in `Detumble` |
| `SlewLimiter` | Estimated attitude, angular rate, angular acceleration, target quaternion, B-field, slew rate limit | Magnetic moment vector, via a cascaded control law. Outer P loop on the attitude error angle (capped to the slew limit) produces a rate command, inner rate PID loop (using angular acceleration as its derivative term) turns that into a torque, then computes the magnetic moment as the cross product of B and torque divided by the squared magnitude of B. | `SUN_POINTING`, `ANTENNA_POINTING`, and `EARTH_LIMB_POINTING`'s `TRACKING` substate |
| `PointingController` | Estimated attitude, angular rate, target quaternion, B-field | Magnetic moment vector. Quaternion PD law computes torque from attitude/rate error against the target, converted to moment the same way as `SlewLimiter` | `ATTITUDE_HOLD`'s `HOLDING` substate |


### Commands {.unnumbered .unlisted}

| Mnemonic | Args | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `RESET` | — | Force transition back to current mode's initial substate |


## State Machine {.unnumbered .unlisted}

`AdcsApplication` uses a hierarchical F' state machine. A single `switchMode: Adcs.Mode` signal defined at the top level is inherited by all leaf states, making mode switches valid from any nested substate.


```
OFF
  entry: send ManagerControl.OFF via sunSensorControl
         call magnetorquerLock(true) and immuDisturbanceOut(true)
  exit:  send ManagerControl.ON  via sunSensorControl
         call magnetorquerLock(false) and immuDisturbanceOut(false)

DETUMBLE
  └─ RUNNING
       on tick: read cached current/previous B-field
                DetumbleController(currentBField, previousBField) → momentVector
                send momentVectorOut

SUN_POINTING
  ├─ ACQUIRING       (on tick: check cached sun-vector freshness; wait for valid sun vector)
  └─ TRACKING
       on tick: read cached attitude, angular rate, angular acceleration, B-field, sun-vector freshness
                SlewLimiter(attitude, angularRate, angularAccel, targetQuaternion, bField, 0.04°/s) → momentVector
                send momentVectorOut

ANTENNA_POINTING
  ├─ ACQUIRING       (on tick: compute ground station quaternion via GNSS ephemeris)
  └─ TRACKING
       on tick: read cached attitude, angular rate, angular acceleration, B-field
                SlewLimiter(attitude, angularRate, angularAccel, targetQuaternion, bField, 0.04°/s) → momentVector
                send momentVectorOut

EARTH_LIMB_POINTING
  ├─ ACQUIRING       (on tick: acquire lit Earth limb target + solar optimization)
  └─ TRACKING
       on tick: read cached attitude, angular rate, angular acceleration, B-field, star-tracker freshness
                SlewLimiter(attitude, angularRate, angularAccel, targetQuaternion, bField, 0.04°/s) → momentVector
                send momentVectorOut

ATTITUDE_HOLD
  └─ HOLDING
       on tick: read cached attitude, angular rate, B-field
                PointingController(attitude, angularRate, targetQuaternion, bField) → momentVector
                send momentVectorOut

# Inherited by all leaf states:
on switchMode(Adcs.Mode.Off)               enter OFF
on switchMode(Adcs.Mode.Detumble)          enter DETUMBLE
on switchMode(Adcs.Mode.SunPointing)       enter SUN_POINTING
on switchMode(Adcs.Mode.AntennaPointing)   enter ANTENNA_POINTING
on switchMode(Adcs.Mode.EarthLimbPointing) enter EARTH_LIMB_POINTING
on switchMode(Adcs.Mode.AttitudeHold)      enter ATTITUDE_HOLD
```

`switchMode` is inherited by every leaf state, so any of the 6 modes can reach any other directly, not just from `OFF`. On entry to `OFF`, `AdcsApplication` locks `MagnetorquerManager` and asserts `ImmuManager`'s disturbance flag; `DETUMBLE` alone runs `bDotCompute`, while `SUN_POINTING`, `ANTENNA_POINTING`, `EARTH_LIMB_POINTING`, and `ATTITUDE_HOLD` all run the same `slewRateCompute` + `quaternionPdCompute` → `momentVectorOut` pipeline each tick, differing only in target source.

`SUN_POINTING`, `ANTENNA_POINTING`, and `EARTH_LIMB_POINTING` also each nest the same `ACQUIRING` → `TRACKING` substate pattern, moving to `TRACKING` once that mode's target is acquired: `SUN_POINTING` waits for a valid sun vector; `ANTENNA_POINTING` computes the ground station quaternion from GNSS ephemeris; `EARTH_LIMB_POINTING` acquires the lit Earth limb target. `DETUMBLE` and `ATTITUDE_HOLD` each have a single unconditional substate (`RUNNING`, `HOLDING` respectively) with no internal transition.

Reference: [FPP inherited transitions](https://github.com/nasa/fpp/blob/main/docs/users-guide/Defining-State-Machines.adoc#inherited-transitions), [FPP substates](https://github.com/nasa/fpp/blob/main/docs/users-guide/Defining-State-Machines.adoc#substates)


## Notes {.unnumbered .unlisted}

**Internal control flow**:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    Imu["IMMUManager"] -->|immuDataIn| AF
    Sun["SunSensorManager"] -->|sunIntensitiesIn| AF
    Star["StarTrackerManager"] -->|attitudeIn| AF
    AF["AttitudeFilter<br/>(Kalman filter)"] --> DC["DetumbleController<br/>(Detumble)"]
    AF --> SL["SlewLimiter<br/>(SunPointing/AntennaPointing/EarthLimbPointing)"]
    AF --> PC["PointingController<br/>(AttitudeHold)"]
    DC --> Out["momentVectorOut"]
    SL --> Out
    PC --> Out
    Out --> Mtq["MagnetorquerManager"]
```
